title.narrative: Reponse rapide centrée autour des cas suspects de cholera en République démocratique du Congo

description.narrative: The main objective of this project is to provide water, sanitation and hygiene assistance to vulnerable communities affected by cholera in the DRC. This UNICEF project carries out case-area targeted interventions in and around households with suspected cholera cases. The approach includes early detection, the distribution of cholera kits, household disinfection, hygiene promotion, and the establishment of manual chlorination points, among other activities. The project provides life-saving assistance to 108,000 people, including 19,246 women, 15,271 men, 73,483 children, and 16,200 persons with disabilities.
